title: nmrForge: automation, parameter optimisation and quality control for Bruker multidimensional NMR data
description: nmrForge automates Bruker multidimensional NMR processing with NMRPipe and SMILE, records processing parameters and quality-control decisions, and provides spectrum viewing and peak localization. Version 1.0.8 / API 1.1.4 adds continuous resolution scoring and exports the component scores for window and baseline optimization during reference construction. Candidate windows share representative traces and reference peaks. The 38-column peak-table contract is retained.
